title: Crucible compliance rule
description: One compliance control expressed as data. Rules read the IR and nothing else. Adding a framework means adding files, never writing code. DRAFT - freezes 27 Aug 2026.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never reused, never renumbered. Appears verbatim in the report and in the ledger.

title.description: One line, imperative, stating the desired state rather than the violation.

frameworks.description: Cross-framework control IDENTIFIERS only. CIS Benchmark text must never be reproduced here.

severity.description: Drives Crucible selection: only high and critical findings are verified against a twin.

assert.description: Expression over the IR. Evaluates to true, false or unknown. A null path yields unknown, never false.

applies_to.description: Guard. A rule that does not apply is reported not_applicable, never as a silent pass.

rationale.description: Our own prose, stating a consequence rather than restating the title. Never CIS Benchmark text.

remediation.description: Per-render-target command sequences. Ordered, and safe to paste top to bottom without self-lockout.

references.description: Public URLs or document identifiers. STIG and NIST text may be quoted; CIS text may not.

verify.description: Optional Crucible binding. Presence makes the finding eligible for DEMONSTRATED.
